It began on 20 February 2016 and ended 18 September 2016.{{cite web |url=http://vietnamnews.vn/sports/280131/binh-duong-to-start-at-home.html |title=Binh Duong to start at home |work=vietnamnews.vn |date=21 December 2015 |access-date=24 December 2015 |archive-date=14 April 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160414235204/http://vietnamnews.vn/sports/280131/binh-duong-to-start-at-home.html |url-status=dead }} ==Changes from last season== ===Team changes=== The following teams had changed division since the 2015 season. {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} ====To V.League 1==== '''Promoted from [[2015 V.League 2|V.League 2]]''' * [[Saigon FC]] {{col-2}} ====From V.League 1==== '''Relegated to [[2016 V.League 2]]''' * [[Dong Nai FC]] {{col-end}} ===Rule changes=== In season 2016, the club finishing in the 14th position would be relegated to [[V.League 2|V-League 2]]. The club that had finished in the 13th position would face the winner of a play-off between the V-League 2's second, third and fourth place clubs for a place in the 2017 V.League 1 season. ===Name changes=== *[[Long An FC|Dong Tam Long An]] changed their name to Long An FC in December 2015.{{cite web|title=CLB Đồng Tâm Long An chính thức đổi tên|url=https://thanhnien.vn/clb-dong-tam-long-an-chinh-thuc-doi-ten-post1314966.html/|language=Vietnamese|website=thanhnien.vn|date=12 December 2015 |access-date=2 December 2022}} *In April 2016 with only four matches remaining, promoted side [[Saigon FC|Hanoi FC]] relocated to [[Ho Chi Minh City]] and renamed Saigon FC. This was with only four matchdays played{{cite web|url=http://www.vnleague.com/vdqg-vleague/thong-bao/6732-VPF-ban-hanh-Thong-bao-chinh-thuc-ve-viec-doi-ten-cua-CLB-Ha-Noi.html|title=» VĐQG - Toyota V.League 1 - 2017 » Thông Báo|access-date=24 April 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171114093102/http://www.vnleague.com/vdqg-vleague/thong-bao/6732-VPF-ban-hanh-Thong-bao-chinh-thuc-ve-viec-doi-ten-cua-CLB-Ha-Noi.html|archive-date=14 November 2017|url-status=dead}} ==Teams==
